pattern: Share 3/6: 15 wrong adversarial-break-v1 runs. 7 answered wrong, 1 invalid submission, 4 ran out of steps, 3 Sonnet timeouts. (1) Chart definer attack (ADV-DEFINER-01 / ADV-COMPOSITE-01): every Chart ranking ranks PlotUtilities.drift first (4 valid, 1 rejected). The 2 Chart runs with no answer were heading the same way. Each one read the gold adapter body (nudge/resolve) in full and called it 'correct if drift is correct'. Each one assumed, without checking, that drift should be point2 - point1. None searched tests/, so PlotUtilitiesTests.testDrift (the pin that decides it) never appeared in any of the 7 runs. 6 of 7 reproduced 112.5 vs 87.5, Opus by hand and the rest with their own Java/Python harnesses. Those values cannot tell drift from the adapter, so seeing them did not help. Sonnet also orders the pass-through hops rim/ring/getArcBounds at ranks 2-4, above the gold, which is why the gold lands at rank 5. (2) ADV-MASK-01: all 3 answers rank NumberUtils.overlay first because its field/word shift asymmetry looks wrong locally. Opus never saw the second caller (it grepped overlay inside NumberUtils.java only), so that is a retrieval failure. Both Sonnet runs found BitField.setValue's pre-shifted _mask call and still misread or ignored it. run-008 even wrote that m=_mask is correct for setValue, then tested with an unshifted 0xFF field. Rankings follow strict depth order, with the gold at 3-4. (3) No-answer runs: all 7 had already read the gold body. Haiku used up its 50 steps after reading the full chain, mostly re-grepping signatures. CONV-LONG run-002 had even printed the wrong shift (256 vs 8) and then never submitted. The 3 Sonnet timeouts last wrote their trajectory 39-50 s into the run, ending on a tool output, then sat silent for about 250 s until SIGTERM. The reports count these as hung requests, though a hung shell command (they were hunting for a build tool) cannot be ruled out. (4) Infrastructure: the defects4j runner failed in every run except sonnet46t (missing Perl String::Interpolate, and no mvn/ant), so only 1 of 15 actually executed the test. Several Sonnet runs probed parent-repo git history and searched outside the workspace for ant/junit, both prohibited by the prompt. Nothing leaked.

runs.rationale_summary: Read the whole chain, including nudge's body, by step 15. The d4j runner failed (String::Interpolate missing, no mvn), so it built its own Arc2D harness, which printed 112.5 vs 87.5 and labelled point1-point2 drift 'Current (wrong)' and point2-point1 'Correct'. Steps 31-50 re-read drift/ring/rim with greps limited to ./source (testDrift never seen) until the 50-step limit, with no submission.

Read compose's (1L << width) - 1 at step 14 and overlay at steps 25-26. Its only harness checked the expected value ('Match: true'). It then surveyed sibling Conversion methods and reached BitField.setValue's overlay(..., _shift_count, bitCount(_mask), _mask) call at steps 46-47, just before the 50-step limit, with no submission.

Found overlay's (index + at) * width at step 23, and its harness printed 'Shift (wrong): 256 / Shift should be: 8' at step 25, so it had located the fault. It then spent steps 26-50 re-listing method signatures in Conversion/NumberUtils/BitField and never submitted.

A 7-step trace showed the nudge and drift bodies. The evidence_chain says drift returns 'point1 - point2 (unexploded minus exploded)' and that 87.5 needs a -12.5 delta, so 'the drift direction looks reversed'. All greps were over source/, so the testDrift pin was never seen, and nudge ended up 2nd.

It read compose's unpositioned field at step 3 but blamed overlay because 'the mask leaves out the dstPos offset (at)'. It grepped for overlay only inside NumberUtils.java, so BitField.setValue's pre-shifted _mask call was never seen. Ranking: overlay, combine, compose.

runs.secondary_mode: BUDGET_OR_TIMEOUT (step-47 submission rejected method_not_found for RingPlot::draw; 50-step limit hit before resubmitting)
runs.rationale_summary: Its harness reproduced 112.5 vs 87.5. The rejected submission claimed 'the correct drift should be point2 - point1' and called resolve 'correct if drift() returns the right value', putting drift first and the gold resolve 5th. tests/ was never searched.

A Python trace gave 112.5 vs 87.5. The evidence_chain says 'drift() has reversed subtraction order: uses point1-point2 instead of point2-point1' and 'resolve() is correct, bug is upstream'. Its drift grep covered source/ only, and the pass-through rim/ring/getArcBounds were ranked 2-4, above the gold.

Its harness reproduced 112.5 vs 87.5. The evidence_chain says drift 'should be point2-point1 (exploded minus unexploded)' and that nudge 'is correct assuming drift is correct'. It ranked rim 2nd (argument order could be swapped there), with nudge 5th behind ring and getArcBounds, and never searched tests/.

At steps 31-32 its harness gave 112.5 vs 87.5 and a 'corrected drift'. A step-42 comment says 'drift returns point1-point2, but for explosion direction should be point2-point1'. The remaining steps went on hunting for ant/junit outside the workspace and probing git history (prohibited) until the 50-step limit.

By step 14 it had read widen (the wordOffset guard) and apply's '(i + a) * n' line. d4j and mvn failed. After the step-17 'find /usr -name mvn' the trajectory was last written 39 s in, then nothing until the 300 s SIGTERM. That fits a hung request, though a hung command cannot be ruled out.

Read compose (step 7) and overlay (step 14) and never looked for overlay's other caller. d4j, mvn and ant all failed during the build-tool hunt (steps 15-19). The trajectory was last written about 50 s in, then silent until the 300 s SIGTERM.

At steps 26-27 it found setValue's overlay(holder, value, 0, _shift_count, bitCount(_mask), _mask) call. Its harness comment even notes that m_current = _mask is correct for that caller. It then tested with an unshifted field of 0xFF, decided 'the mask should also incorporate at', and ranked overlay first, setValue 7th and compose 4th, in strict depth order.

At steps 22-26 it viewed setValue's call to overlay with the pre-shifted _mask, but the evidence_chain says overlay 'should be m = field << (at + index * width)', backed by a harness showing 0x12345600 vs 0xF12345600. It ranked setValue 7th and compose 4th, behind combine and widen.

By step 14 it had read the whole chain, including overlay's '(index + at) * width', and step 3 had already shown the sibling 'i * 16 + dstPos'. d4j and mvn failed. After a build-tool search at step 17 the trajectory was last written about 48 s in, then silent until the 300 s SIGTERM. This matches the family's 'hung request' exclusions.

The working runner reported only 'Failing tests: 1'. Its own harness gave 112.5 vs 87.5 and showed that 'drift = point2 - point1' produces 87.5. The evidence_chain says 'the drift direction is inverted ... should be point2 - point1'. tests/ was never searched (testDrift unseen), and rim/ring/getArcBounds were ranked above nudge.
